annotations.title: Size a multifamily construction loan three ways

description: Runs the site's construction loan sizer on your project: the HUD 221(d)(4) loan (lower of 87%/90% of cost and the 1.15/1.11 coverage test, with HUD's construction-interest estimate and upfront MIP), the bank regulatory ceiling (80% of value and 15%-of-value HVCRE equity, plus your bank's loan-to-cost if given) and, if you give its loan-to-cost, a debt fund. Returns loan, binding limit, equity needed and interest.

as_completed_value.description: Appraised value as completed, in dollars.

bank_ltc_pct.description: Your bank's own loan-to-cost policy, percent. Omit to see only the regulatory ceiling.

bank_spread_pct.description: Quoted bank spread over SOFR, percent. Needed for the bank interest estimate.

construction_months.description: Construction period in months; default is the Census national average for 20+ unit buildings.

fund_ltc_pct.description: Quoted debt fund loan-to-cost, percent. Omit to leave the fund out.

fund_spread_pct.description: Quoted debt fund spread over SOFR, percent.

hud_rate_pct.description: HUD note rate in percent; default 5.54 (median note rate on FHA apartment loans endorsed in the year to 2026-09-30).

stabilized_noi.description: Projected stabilized net operating income, dollars per year.

total_development_cost.description: Total development cost including land, in dollars, e.g. 48000000.
